title: 재외공관주재무관의 대외직명에 관한 규칙 / queue:ANNEX:0000:00:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
[Attached Table] <Amended on Apr. 19, 1995; Aug. 14, 2006>
Table of External Official Titles for Military Attachés Stationed at Diplomatic Missions Abroad (Related to Article 3)

| Position or duties | Official title in Korean | Official title in English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The highest-ranking officer at the diplomatic mission among attachés representing the Army, Navy, and Air Force collectively | 국방무관 | Defense Attache |
| Persons other than the above | 국방무관보좌관 | Assistant Defense Attache |
| The highest-ranking officer at the diplomatic mission among attachés representing each respective armed service | 육군무관 | Army Attache |
| The same position as above, representing the Navy | 해군무관 | Naval Attache |
| The same position as above, representing the Air Force | 공군무관 | Air Force Attache |
| Persons other than the above representing the Army | 육군무관보좌관 | Assistant Army Attache |
| Persons other than the above representing the Navy | 해군무관보좌관 | Assistant Naval Attache |
| Persons other than the above representing the Air Force | 공군무관보좌관 | Assistant Air Force Attache |
| Persons in charge of national defense research and development | 국방과학연구개발무관 | Defense Research and Development Attache |
| Persons in charge of military logistics | 국방군수무관 | Defense Logistics Attache |
